svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Rounded $0 Local mark, v4
svg.desc: The rounded ticket family has a broad capsule-like left end that curves naturally into the same local endpoint. The outer silhouette is a single contour and a single green fill. The price tag and local point form one continuous outer path, with no separate pointer or visible seam. Original, unadopted concept; any lettering is editable.
